name: Splinterblade
desc:
The King of Etrea wielded the legendary "Splinterblade", which is what the [Shattered Katana](weapon:shattered_katana) is fashioned after.

[Bookkeeper Andros](entity:bookkeeper_andros) tells of the King that "much like the Splinterblade that the King is famed for, the legends say that the deal he struck split his soul into three parts in order to accomplish the feat."
